title: 第159章 季淮
slug: 电竞世界冠军选秀c位出道
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

顺位发布结束后，#BeaRiver#和#江执屿两亿#等词条相继登上各大社交平台热搜。

互联网也毫不意外地再次掀起了一阵“江执屿热”，关于他的所有话题和帖子都获得了惊人的浏览量和互动数。

演播厅的直播结束，江执屿刚走出两步，突然被一个工作人员喊住：“江执屿。”

“怎么了？”

“今天下午有个综艺需要出营录制，你可以找宿管要一下自己的手机，我们两点宿舍楼下集合。”

“好，我知道了。”

由于这次是顺位排名前四的练习生参与录制，林森和米蓝也和他一起去找了宿管要回手机。

江执屿拿到手机的第一件事，就是给林石发消息。

【Rr：怎么样了？】

【林石：？啥？】

【Rr：找到临时队员了吗。】

【林石：你怎么有手机，你也偷藏了？】

【Rr：……】

【Rr：顺位发布完休息时间，晚点要出营录制。】

【林石：哦哦！】

【林石：还没找到呢，一直没合适的。】

【Rr：（个人名片）】

【Rr：问问他。】

【林石：这是？】

【Rr：季淮，现在在XSG二队，很准。】

江执屿和季淮相识于一个雨夜。

那晚，雨下得很急。

江执屿刚下晚自习，被突如其来的雨淋了个透，一路小跑着躲进了路边店铺的屋檐下。

夜空黑压压的，瓢泼的大雨往下倾泻着。

他抬头看着一时半会儿估计不会停的雨，从外套口袋里掏出了自己的手机：“喂？”

“你人呢？”电话那头的声音有些闷，带着浓浓的鼻音。

“下雨了，我躲会儿雨，晚点再去找你。”

感冒的景池鼻子里塞着纸团，含糊不清地回复：“那你路上慢点，我再单排几把，你回来再带我上段。”

两家家长在学校附近买了套房子，方便孩子上学日通勤。

他们在同一个学校同一个班级上学，原本都会一起上学回家，但今天景池感冒请假了，于是单独行动的江执屿就被困在了雨里。

江执屿挂断电话，静静站在屋檐下好半晌，雨势没有半点变小的迹象。

他四处张望了一下，身后是一道敞开的门，里面是灯火通明的网吧。

网吧老板是一个大腹便便的光头中年人，面色不善，看着很凶。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After the announcement of the order, terms such as #BeaRiver# and #江智幑二亿# successively appeared on the hot searches on major social platforms.

Unsurprisingly, the Internet has once again set off a wave of "Jiang Zhiyu fever", and all topics and posts about him have received an astonishing number of views and interactions.

The live broadcast in the studio ended. Jiang Zhiyu had just taken two steps when he was suddenly stopped by a staff member: "Jiang Zhiyu."

"What's wrong?"

"There is a variety show that needs to be recorded this afternoon. You can ask the dormitory manager for your mobile phone. We will meet downstairs in the dormitory at two o'clock."

"Okay, I get it."

Since the top four trainees were participating in the recording this time, Lin Sen and Mi Lan also went to the dormitory with him to get their phones back.

The first thing Jiang Zhiyu did when he got his mobile phone was to send a message to Lin Shi.

[Rr: How's it going?】

[Lin Shi:?What?】

[Rr: Have you found the temporary team members?】

[Lin Shi: Why do you have a mobile phone? You also hid it secretly?】

[Rr:……]

[Rr: After announcing the rest time in order, I will leave camp for recording later.】

[Lin Shi: Oh!】

[Lin Shi: I haven’t found it yet, there’s never been a suitable one.】

[Rr: (personal business card)]

[Rr: Ask him.】

[Lin Shi: Is this?】

[Rr: Ji Huai, now in the second team of XSG, very accurate.】

Jiang Zhiyu and Ji Huai met on a rainy night.

That night, it rained heavily.

Jiang Zhiyu had just finished his evening self-study and was drenched by the sudden rain. He ran all the way and hid under the eaves of a roadside shop.

The night sky was dark and heavy rain was pouring down.

He looked up at the rain that was probably not going to stop for a while, and took out his mobile phone from his coat pocket: "Hello?"

"Where are you?" The voice on the other end of the phone was a bit muffled, with a thick nasal tone.

"It's raining. I'll hide from the rain for a while and I'll find you later."

Jingchi, who had a cold and had a ball of paper stuffed in his nose, replied vaguely: "Then you go slower on the road, I will queue up a few more times, and you will lead me up the section when you come back."

Two parents bought a house near the school to make it easier for their children to commute during school days.

They went to the same school and the same class, and would have gone to school and returned home together, but today Jingchi had a cold and asked for leave, so Jiang Zhiyu, who was acting alone, was trapped in the rain.

Jiang Zhiyu hung up the phone and stood quietly under the eaves for a long time. The rain showed no sign of letting up.

He looked around and saw an open door behind him, which contained a brightly lit Internet cafe.

The owner of the internet cafe is a bald middle-aged man with a big belly and a sinister look on his face.
